s1.desc: an igloo kitchen with curved ice-block walls and mint-green counters

s2.desc: a kitchen drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a porthole window, a hanging fish ornament, a steaming pot on the stove and a carrot and green onions on the counter

beats.text: Polly reaches toward the steaming pot on the stove while Pax stands at the counter with his back turned
Polly grabs the handles of the pot with both flippers
Polly snaps her flippers back from the hot handles, wincing with her eyes squeezed shut
Polly holds her stinging flippers against her chest, wincing, while Pax turns around to look at her
Pax waddles over behind Polly toward the stove
Polly clasps her flippers together with worried brows while Pax stands just behind her, peering at the pot

spans.notes: v4 called this a slow pull-back; phase correlation of the hood and floor regions shows 0.0 px shift f0->f76, so the camera is locked
static 20 frames: Pax leans over the steaming pot, Polly a sliver at the left edge; the pull back starts at f97
pull back from Pax at the pot to a two-shot as he lifts the pot; settles at f113

spans.view: with a stovetop on the counter, a steaming pot and a wooden spoon

beats.text: Pax, smiling with his eyes closed, lowers the steaming pot onto the left burner in front of Polly
Pax leans over the pot looking at Polly while she lifts a flipper to her beak, staring at him
Pax straightens up with a calm closed-eye smile while Polly clasps her flippers at her chest
Polly gazes at Pax with her flippers at her chest as little hearts float above her head, while he stands beside her
Polly leans over and nuzzles Pax's cheek with a blush
Pax turns around to face away while Polly settles back with a happy smile
Pax walks off toward the back with his back turned, getting smaller, while Polly watches him go
Polly picks up the wooden spoon and stirs the pot while Pax keeps walking away

spans.view: with a stone chimney hood, a shelf of bottles, a gooseneck tap and a dish cabinet of plates and bowls

beats.text: Pax waddles forward with teary eyes, holding his flippers against his chest, while Polly stands at the counter with her back turned
Pax raises his sore flippers to his beak and blows on them, tears running down his cheeks
Pax squeezes his eyes shut and wails with his beak open, hugging his flippers to his body

spans.notes: Pax walks toward the viewer and grows; Polly is seen from behind the whole span
